comment: Each token is stored in fragments and joined at run time, so this file does not contain the strings it forbids and does not have to exempt itself.

exemptReasons.AGENTS.md: Section 1 is the clean-room rule itself, and a rule has to name what it forbids.
exemptReasons.README.md: States plainly what this project is and is not a derivative of.
exemptReasons.docs/KICKOFF.md: Records where the observable behaviour is read from.
exemptReasons.scripts/gates/provenance.js: Explains in prose what it looks for.
exemptReasons.package-lock.json: Checked separately, by dependency name rather than by substring, because a lockfile carries integrity hashes that collide with any short token.
